intent: Cross fresh meadow and cut rows, hop the hay stacks, pass through the loading barn and finish in warm golden fields. Expert redesign: hay balers and suspended pitchfork weights.

sections.name: The fresh meadow
sections.lesson: Follow the farm path over low fences. Green is open. Amber warns before the press falls.
